title: Dariusz piecze z czułością
description: Dariusz nuci z zamkniętymi oczami, mieszając masę w groteskowo delikatnym stroju.

prompts.image: Native vertical 9:16 frame in the same late-1990s Polish kitchen. Exact Dariusz blissfully stirs thick cake batter in one large ceramic bowl, eyes almost closed. He wears the identical thick opaque pale-pink bib apron with one red heart covering collarbone, chest, stomach and front to mid-thigh, plus opaque high-waisted red satin athletic shorts fully covering waist, crotch, hips and buttocks; no shirt. Hairy shoulders and arms are visible but nipples and chest front remain covered. Medium shot from mid-thigh to head, bowl and hands lower-middle, face upper-middle, cake tins and pastry bag foreground. Exact photorealism, warm tungsten and subtle S-VHS/16 mm texture. No white T-shirt, nudity, text or artifacts.
prompts.animation: 2.5-second medium shot. Dariusz stirs the thick batter in a steady circle, gently sways one hip and hums with eyes half closed; his braid moves naturally. Keep the camera almost static and preserve identity, clothes, bowl, tools and kitchen. No new objects, cuts, morphing, text or watermark.
